annotations.title: Validate an x402 Service Listing Free

description: Free provider listing preflight for the 0.50 USDC Ontario launch passport. Validates public service metadata, runs a live readiness scan (8 s budget) that saves a public signed readiness report, and an exact-URL Bazaar lookup. Returns a summary with grade, score, report_published, Bazaar presence and the top findings, or endpoint_unreachable with the fix when the endpoint returns no HTTP response. verify_now=false skips the scan and the report. Never publishes a listing, signs or spends.

asset.description: Payment token contract accepted by the provider on the declared network.

buyer_query.description: Public task phrase used for the point-in-time Bazaar retrieval audit. It may appear in the public profile.

category.description: Public capability category for the service, not a claim of certification.

description.description: Public buyer task, expected result, and important service limitations; do not include confidential text.

endpoint.description: Provider-owned public HTTPS x402 endpoint to list. Never include secrets or sensitive query parameters.

mcp_remote_url.description: Optional public MCP remote for read-only initialize and tools/list checks.

mcp_server_json_url.description: Optional public MCP Registry record or exact-search JSON URL.

mcp_server_name.description: Optional exact MCP Registry server name.

method.description: HTTP method used to call the provider's endpoint.

name.description: Public service name displayed on the provider profile.

network.description: Provider payment network, for example base or eip155:8453. Ontario publication itself uses Base USDC.

owner_contact.description: Optional provider contact retained for operations and omitted from public profiles. Omit when unnecessary; never send wallet credentials.

owner_url.description: Public website identifying the provider; publication does not verify legal identity.

price_atomic.description: Optional provider price in six-decimal USDC units: 10000 equals 0.01 USDC. Must match price_usdc when supplied.

price_usdc.description: Provider endpoint price in decimal USDC, at most six decimal places. This is separate from Ontario's 0.50 USDC publication fee.

source.description: Privacy-safe aggregate acquisition bucket; never a URL or query.

tags.description: Public capability tags for discovery, up to ten relevant labels.

verify_now.description: Live readiness scan that saves a public signed readiness report, plus an exact-URL Bazaar lookup; false skips the scan, the report and the lookup. No listing is published and no payment is made.

name: ontario_validate-service

verification.description: Optional public readiness observation; metadata validation alone does not verify readiness.
